CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.review_dependencies (
 source_id text NOT NULL, policy_slug text NOT NULL, evidence_slug text NOT NULL,
 evidence_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(length(evidence_sha256)=64),
 PRIMARY KEY(source_id,policy_slug,evidence_slug),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_id,policy_slug) REFERENCES ultrabrain.memory_policies ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_review_dependents(target_source text,target_slug text)
RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $f$
DECLARE rec record; next_revision integer;
BEGIN
 -- UNION (not UNION ALL) makes cycles finite; lock affected policies deterministically.
 FOR rec IN
  WITH RECURSIVE affected(slug) AS (
   SELECT d.policy_slug FROM ultrabrain.review_dependencies d
    WHERE d.source_id=target_source AND d.evidence_slug=target_slug
   UNION
   SELECT d.policy_slug FROM ultrabrain.review_dependencies d JOIN affected a ON d.evidence_slug=a.slug
    WHERE d.source_id=target_source
  )
  SELECT p.slug FROM ultrabrain.memory_policies p JOIN affected a ON a.slug=p.slug
   WHERE p.source_id=target_source AND p.status='active' ORDER BY p.slug FOR UPDATE OF p
 LOOP
  UPDATE ultrabrain.memory_policies SET status='review_required',revision=revision+1,updated_at=now()
   WHERE source_id=target_source AND slug=rec.slug AND status='active' RETURNING revision INTO next_revision;
  IF FOUND THEN
   INSERT INTO ultrabrain.memory_policy_history(source_id,slug,revision,event_id,request_hash,actor_key,snapshot)
   VALUES(target_source,rec.slug,next_revision,'reference:'||next_revision,'reference-trigger','reference-trigger',
    jsonb_build_object('status','review_required','reason','A referenced resource changed or was retired'));
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $f$

CREATE TRIGGER ultrabrain_review_dependencies_native_change AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.pages
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.review_dependency_page_changed()

CREATE TRIGGER ultrabrain_review_dependencies_retirement AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON ultrabrain.memory_policies
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.review_dependency_policy_changed()

DO $migration$
DECLARE rec record;
BEGIN
 -- Prior releases did not index citation dependencies. Do not invent provenance
 -- from an undecoded URI or silently preserve a stronger validity guarantee.
 FOR rec IN UPDATE ultrabrain.memory_policies SET status='review_required',revision=revision+1,updated_at=now()
   WHERE status='active' AND assertion_kind='source_quote' RETURNING source_id,slug,revision
 LOOP
  INSERT INTO ultrabrain.memory_policy_history(source_id,slug,revision,event_id,request_hash,actor_key,snapshot)
   VALUES(rec.source_id,rec.slug,rec.revision,'migration-0007:'||rec.revision,'migration-0007','migration-0007',
    jsonb_build_object('status','review_required','reason','Re-review existing source_quote to register citation dependencies'));
 END LOOP;
END $migration$
